description: The Sources tab holds at most one row per source_id, so a rerun corrects a contaminated citation in place rather than adding a second copy beside it.
why_it_exists: Four Sources rows for one matter were written with contaminated citation data. Append Sources was changed from append to appendOrUpdate matched on source_id and the job was rerun. The census (2026-08-21) exists because both outcomes - four rows corrected, or four more rows added - look identical in the n8n execution log. A row count read back off the sheet was the only honest way to tell which had happened.

expect.target_matter_example: MAT-20260101-001 (synthetic stand-in for the real matter the census named; format and length preserved)

assertions: No source_id value appears on more than one Sources row anywhere in the tab.
For any single matter, the row count equals the count of distinct source_id values.
Rows with a blank source_id, and a stray literal header row where source_id == 'source_id', must be excluded before counting.
For a nominated matter, title, url, publisher, source_type, verification_status and pinpoints must be reported so citation integrity can be checked by eye against the live sheet.
Switching a writer from append to appendOrUpdate must be verified by reading row counts back, never by reading the execution log.
target_unresolved_reason: kind is "invariant": not executed by harness/run.js.
